title: Talent partner personal playbook: reflection, goals, and manager prep
content:
Quick context and purpose:
- Working doc for my personal prep ahead of manager 1:1s, calibration meetings, and end-of-quarter self-reflection. Rough, unpolished.
- Use as a running log: wins, concrete examples, blockers, asks, and development objectives.

Recent wins (Q4 2025 -> Q1 2026):
- Built a repeatable hiring intake checklist for Platform Eng roles; decreased avg time-to-hire from 52 -> 41 days (source: hiring dashboard).
  - Example: clarified interview rubric for infra reliability candidates; three interviewers used same rubric; feedback more actionable.
- Pilot: onboarding buddy program for new hires in Dedicated product team (3 cohorts) — first-run NPS = 8.1.
- Negotiated RM for Sr TPM offer with hiring manager; kept comp within band while speeding acceptance by 4 business days.

Areas where I need to be explicit in 1:1 / calibration:
- Influence beyond PD: I want to be credited for cross-team hiring cadence improvements; include metric notes and PR links.
- Development ask: shadowing a senior talent partner for executive hiring; request to be included in at least 2 exec searches this year.
- Band promotion readiness: need clear examples of scope expansion to peer-level TP. Draft points below.

Promotion / scope expansion draft bullets (evidence-based):
- Ownership: led full-cycle recruiting for Dedicated infra mini-hub (4 hires, hiring bar maintained) — tracked in hiring spreadsheet (HIRE-2025-dedicated-hub).
- Influence: introduced interview calibration sessions that reduced disagreement rate on hire/no-hire from ~38% -> 16% (sampling notes in calibration-doc).
- Process improvement: created offer cadence playbook (offer-speed improved avg 2 days faster) and risk checklist for complex offers (relocation, equity).

Concrete examples to call out in my self-review (STAR format quick notes):
- Situation: Hiring bottleneck on Serving Runtime SREs (Q4).
  Task: Reduce time-to-hire while keeping quality.
  Action: Implemented targeted sourcing channel, retooled job posting, ran two calibration interviews, and updated scorecard.
  Result: Filled two SRE roles; reopened pipeline for a third; post-hire ramp feedback rated "hiring fit" 4.5/5 from manager.

Development goals (6–12 months):
- Technical fluency: sit in architect sync for serving-runtime at least monthly; learn common tech terms to better screen senior ICs.
- Stakeholder leadership: lead one cross-functional L&D pilot to improve interview training; aim to measure interviewer competency pre/post.
- Coaching: complete internal "coaching for managers" program and apply framework to at least three hiring managers.

Manager asks / 1:1 agenda items (next meeting):
- Ask for sponsorship: assign me as backup lead on exec search for VP of Product to get exposure.
- Promotion roadmap: get clarity on timeline, required artifacts, and recommended sponsor(s).
- Headcount forecast: discuss tentative hires for Q3 (2 ICs in Dedicated infra) and hiring priority.
- Compensation guidance: what is realistic comp stretch for Sr TP vs Lead TP (have market data attached).

Unresolved questions / risks to surface:
- Band compression risk: comp bands for people-ops appear tight for Level X; need to escalate to People Ops leadership.
- Time: juggling L&D pilot and exec search shadowing — what to deprioritize if bandwidth limited?

Actionable TODOs (next 30 days):
- Fill in self-review template draft by 2026-03-05. (status: in-progress).
- Request to be added to VP Product search (owner: manager).
- Share calibration metrics with Hiring Council and link to calibration-doc (owner: me).
- Book monthly "tech sync" seat with serving-runtime PM (owner: me).

Evidence and artifacts to attach to review:
- Hiring dashboard snapshots (Dec 2025 - Feb 2026).
- Calibration session notes + before/after disagreement rates (spreadsheet id: HIRE-CAL-2026).
- Onboarding buddy survey results (survey id: OBX-2026-COHORT1).

Notes to self (raw, rough):
- Keep examples short and quantified — managers skim. Put top 3 bullet points first.
- For promotion: show increased scope + repeatable impact. Avoid soft language alone.
- Prepare one story that shows influence on policy (offer playbook).
- Ask manager for two out-of-band reviewers for promotion packet.

Tone checklist for manager conversation:
- Confident, fact-first, show curiosity.
- Avoid sounding defensive; frame gaps as growth plan.
- Have specific asks (sponsorship, timeline).

End-of-doc quick log (dates):
- 2026-02-20: created baseline doc.
- 2026-02-26: added calibration metrics.
- 2026-03-03: added onboarding NPS snapshot.
- 2026-03-10: draft self-review complete, ready for manager review.

Random scratch lines (save for later):
- Could pull market comps from Radford next week and update comp ask.
- Follow up with Maya on interview training materials (she has sample slides).
- Consider running a micro-retro with hiring managers post-hire for continuous feedback.

End.
